A digitizer/readout failure or unintended disablement is more consistent than a global DAQ failure, but an intermittent or late-run LVDS-path failure remains possible because the LVDS summaries are aggregate and board-matching telemetry is unavailable. No historical case is an exact match: run 1620 is only a digitizer-lockup analogy, and run 2126 is only a localized LVDS/readout-path analogy.
